rv.q: Work in this gentre have been upping the ante on troubled relationship between awkward progenitors and progeny.
Overall, Elf left this Grinch-inclined critic with expectations pleasantly confounded, and full of seasonal good cheer.
There's an infectious enjoyment to the proceedings.
Efficient, slick, even cynical: Elf is all these.
This is a show that doesn't so much invoke the spirit of Christmas as market it.
Expecting a bit more bang for my buck at these prices, I was rather disappointed by the somewhat sparse set design that was supplemented by the now ubiquitous filmed projections.
Elf the Musical is no perfect snowflake, but, thanks to a strong turn from Forster it’s not a total turkey either.

cn.t: Critics find this sugary adaptation of the Will Ferrell film professionally staged but formulaic, with mixed reactions to its saccharine sentiment. Some embrace its feel-good Christmas spirit, while others find it overly sweet and predictable.
